narrative.overview: The money is a savings passbook. A narrow blue cover band sits on top, white pages lie on a pale blue-grey ground, and everything that is a movement is a ruled line with its number in a column. The mood is calm and reliable: ink on paper, nothing glowing, nothing shouting. The headline figure is set in a serif and earns its place by being the total of the lines below it. Density is low and glanceable, built for one thumb on an iPhone installed as a PWA. Identity comes from three things only: the passbook-blue cover, the serif figures against a plain grotesk, and a single red stamp.
keyCharacteristics: Blue cover band, white pages, hairline rules (1px hairline), a 2px blue rule under the ledger header.
Serif for figures and headings, grotesk for everything else, tabular lining numerals in every amount.
Flat colour. Depth comes from borders and tonal steps, not shadows.
One reserved red, the stamp, for "registrato" only.
Light and dark themes share one token set; dark follows the system setting.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Stamp red marks a movement as registered and has no other use. Errors use alert red; emphasis uses blue or weight.

rules.name: The Flat Colour Rule
rules.body: No gradients, no glow, no coloured balance card. A fill is one solid token.

rules.name: The Darker Paper Rule
rules.body: Dark mode darkens the paper (navy ground, navy page) and lightens the blue; it never switches to black with neon.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every amount, date and running total carries the .num class (tabular, lining numerals) so columns align. A number in a column without it is a bug.

rules.name: The Serif For Counted Things Rule
rules.body: Serif is for figures and headings. Prose, buttons, chips and labels are always Work Sans.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from borders, tone and spacing. A shadow is allowed only on a control that must read as pressable above content, and stays soft and low-opacity.

dos: Do put every amount, date and running total in a .num column with tabular lining numerals.
Do keep the stamp red (#c8102e) for "registrato" confirmations only.
Do build surfaces from a 1px hairline border, a white page and 1rem radius before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep done obligations visible and struck through until month end.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and primary actions at 48px.
Do respect safe-area insets at the top (cover band) and bottom (tab bar) and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't use a coloured balance card over a feed of icon tiles; this system refuses that category default.
Don't compute or display a backward running balance: balances are edited by hand, so the ledger shows the month-to-date total ("Nel mese").
Don't use gradients, glow shadows or a second reserved accent next to the stamp.
Don't set prose, buttons or labels in the serif, or figures in the grotesk.
Don't use stamp red for errors; errors use alert red.
